coverage.summary: Rent control (AGA-limited rent ceilings) applies only to fully covered units: most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented individually with separate leases). Partially covered units have no rent control. These include new construction with a certificate of occupancy after June 1980, single-family tenancies beginning on or after Jan. 1, 1996, most condominiums and certain subsidized units. Exempt units are outside the ordinance.
coverage.owner_conditions: Golden Duplex exemption: duplex owner-occupied on Dec. 31, 1979 and currently with an owner living in one of the units. Shared kitchen/bath exemption applies only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy (Measure BB). Tenancies started after Nov. 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied are exempt.
coverage.other_conditions: Applies only to fully covered units. Partially covered units are registered but have no rent control. Government-subsidized units (e.g., Section 8, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC) are fully or partially covered depending on unit type and on whether federal law, state law or regulation exempts them from rent control. Fully covered units have a rent ceiling limited by the AGA.

result.notes:
Changes from the input coverage:
1. supersedes_state_rule is set to null. The Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12(d) / state-cap statement is removed from other_conditions because no document in this jurisdiction mentions the state rent cap or § 1947.12.
2. owner_occupied_exemption_max_units is set to null (was 2). The Golden Duplex exemption also requires owner occupancy on Dec. 31, 1979. A general 2-unit owner-occupancy threshold would wrongly exempt duplexes whose owners moved in later. That exemption and the ADU exemption stay in owner_conditions and unverifiable_exemptions.
3. The kitchen/bath condition is reworded to match D006: the landlord must have lived on the property at the start of the tenancy.
4. The construction cutoff (certificate of occupancy on or before 1980-06-30) still follows D009. D006 says 'certificate of occupancy issued after 1980', and both sources say 'built before 1980' for fully covered multifamily units, so coverage of 1980 construction remains unresolved (conflict_flag should stay true).
